candidates.snippet: ### Motivation  Claude Code can run against vLLM through the Anthropic Messages endpoint (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` → `/v1/messages`). candidates.title: qwen3.8: `think: "high"` / `"max"` silently run the default (`medium`); the model's top level `xhigh` is reachable only by a string outside the documented `think` values
candidates.snippet: ### What is the issue?  `/api/show` for `qwen3.8:27b` lists its thinking levels as `[false, "low", "medium", "xhigh"]`, with default `medium`. `/api/chat` accepts values outside that list without any error and runs the default level instead:  - `"high"`: not a Qwen3.8 level, but a common one for other models, so clients send it - `"max"`: accepted by the global validator - `"banana"`: not a valid level for anything  All three return HTTP 200, and the output is byte-identical to `"medium"`.
